sources.title: Bermuda Immigration and Protection (Prohibition of Entry) Order 2026, BR 99/2026

sources.officialityEvidence: Official consolidated BR 99/2026, read through all five pages: operative 17 September 2026, revoking BR 59/2025. Paragraphs 2-3 and the complete Schedule establish the current controlled cohort and document requirements.

sources.title: Bermuda Immigration and Protection Act 1956: sections 25-28
sources.officialityEvidence: Current official consolidated Act. Sections 25-28 establish the bona fide visitor baseline, its conditions and permitted duration; section 28(2) records the amendment effective 15 January 2024.
sources.supportingExcerpt: the period of six months or 180 days (whichever is greater) whether consecutive or cumulative

sources.title: Immigration Updates: new visa-controlled-national Order announced
sources.publisher: Government of Bermuda Ministry of Economy and Labour
sources.officialityEvidence: Minister's government release of 3 September 2026. Its first policy section describes additions and removals, expressly awaiting gazetting; the later BR 99/2026 supplies actual legal effect.
sources.supportingExcerpt: I must note that countries being removed from this list of visa-controlled nationals are Indonesia and Taiwan.

sources.title: Immigration Rules Appendix Visitor: Visa national list, VN 2.2(a)-(b)
sources.officialityEvidence: Current Home Office appendix, expressly linked by the asterisk in Bermuda's 2026 Order. VN 2.2(a)-(b) identify Hong Kong SAR and Macao SAR passports; this is limited incorporation, not adoption of the UK nationality list.

sources.title: Bermuda entry visas: passport and multiple re-entry visa validity
sources.publisher: Government of Bermuda Department of Immigration
sources.officialityEvidence: Live Immigration guidance, last updated 13 April 2026. It still links a 2023 Order, so only the separately stated document-validity instruction is used; its old nationality reference cannot replace BR 99/2026.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The multi re-entry visa and the traveler’s passport must be valid for 45 days

sources.title: Public Advisory Re: Visitor Allowed Length of Stay in Bermuda
sources.publisher: Government of Bermuda Department of Immigration
sources.officialityEvidence: Department's live advisory dated 29 November 2023, describing the cumulative visitor-stay system effective 15 January 2024. Its 180-day operational wording is preserved separately from the Act's six-month alternative.
sources.supportingExcerpt: a cumulative maximum of 180 days in any 12-month period from the first arrival date within those 12 months.

policies.title: Bermuda: ordinary visitor exemptions under the September 2026 Order
policies.summary: The Act permits bona fide visits subject to its conditions. These ordinary-passport nationalities fall outside the 2026 Order's controlled Schedule; Indonesia and Taiwan are expressly removed in the ministerial announcement.
conditions: Ordinary bona fide visitors only; work, residence, special documents, school-party and individual-permission routes are outside this baseline.
Visitors must remain bona fide, avoid statutory exclusion grounds, and hold a departure ticket to a country they may enter. Admission remains subject to border assessment.

Section 28 permits six months or 180 days, whichever is greater, within 12 months, but Immigration describes its operational allowance as cumulative 180 days. Confirm the individual permitted stay with Immigration; months are not converted to days here.
The Schedule's Northern Cyprus entry is not the Republic of Cyprus passport represented by CY. Indonesian and Taiwanese ordinary passports are no longer controlled by this Order.

allowedStays.label: Six months or 180 days, whichever is greater, within any 12-month period
notes: Section 28 counts consecutive or cumulative stay from first landing; the Minister may shorten or terminate it by written notice.
Immigration's operational advisory describes a cumulative 180-day allowance. No conversion of months to days or fresh allowance after each arrival is implied.

policies.title: Bermuda: Hong Kong SAR and Macao SAR visitor exceptions
policies.summary: The 2026 Order expressly incorporates UK-rule exceptions for its starred Chinese-nationality entry. The specified Hong Kong SAR and Macao SAR passports retain ordinary visitor exemption.
conditions: Only the specified SAR-issued passports are covered; this does not exempt mainland Chinese passports or adopt the UK's complete visa regime.
The Act's bona fide visitor, departure-ticket and admission conditions apply. Work, residence, marriage and special-document routes are separate.

Section 28 permits six months or 180 days, whichever is greater, within 12 months, but Immigration describes its operational allowance as cumulative 180 days. Confirm the individual permitted stay with Immigration; months are not converted to days here.

allowedStays.label: Six months or 180 days, whichever is greater, within any 12-month period
notes: Consecutive or cumulative stay, subject to a shorter period imposed by the Minister. Operational Immigration guidance describes the allowance as cumulative 180 days.

policies.title: Bermuda: current controlled nationalities need qualifying travel authorization
policies.summary: Listed ordinary visitors need qualifying Canadian, UK or US multiple re-entry authorization. The passport-only baseline remains visa-required, not an assertion that Bermuda issues its own visitor visa.
conditions: Authorization must permit entry and re-entry and remain valid for 45 days after intended Bermuda departure. The separate spouse/belongs Government-letter exception is outside this ordinary visitor baseline.
Immigration guidance additionally requires the passport and MRV to remain valid for 45 days beyond the visitor stay; that is document validity, not permitted stay.

Applicable incorporated UK exceptions remain separate. No work-permit, school-party, residence or special-document exception is generalized; the revoked 2025 work-permit footnote is not carried forward.
The two Ivory Coast names identify one CI passport; Northern Cyprus is outside the catalog. Meeting document requirements does not guarantee admission.
